info.name: NetLedger
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for testing the NetLedger.Server REST API.

## Variables
- `{{protocol}}` - HTTP or HTTPS (default: http)
- `{{hostname}}` - Server hostname (default: localhost)
- `{{port}}` - Server port (default: 8080)
- `{{apiKey}}` - Bearer token for authentication (see below)
- `{{accountId}}` - Auto-captured account identifier
- `{{entryId}}` - Auto-captured entry identifier
- `{{credentialId}}` - Auto-captured credential identifier

## Credential Setup
The server generates a random admin credential on first run if none is configured. Check the server console for: `created default admin credential: nlk_...`

Alternatively, set `DefaultAdminKey` in your server settings before starting.
